en: A color postcard-style image showing a coastal hilltop fortress overlooking a seaside town. In the foreground are tropical trees, including palm fronds and a flowering tree with vivid red-orange blossoms. Below are red-tiled roofs and low-rise houses; in the distance, on a green hill, a large, light-colored fort dominates the skyline with the ocean visible beyond under a blue sky.
